# SRC-X.5

> An open record of sealed claims, verified at the source. A record says what was predicted and by which criteria, which
> files were fixed and when, when it ran, what came out, and who replicated it. Its id is the SHA-256 of its canonical
> form, so any copy, from any host or network, is checked rather than trusted. Apache 2.0; the specification is CC BY 4.0.

## Read
- [Discovery](.well-known/srcx5.json): versions, head, where everything is
- [All ids](api/ids.json), [head](api/head.json), [the whole chain](api/log.json), one record: api/records/<id>.json
- One record as W3C PROV JSON-LD: api/ld/<id>.jsonld

## Interfaces
- [OpenAPI 3.1](openapi.json) for any HTTP client or SDK
- [JSON Schema](schema/record.schema.json) for the record format
- [JSON-LD context](context.jsonld) for linked data
- [Mirrors](MIRRORS.json): every copy; use the first that answers
- MCP server for AI agents: `python srcx5_mcp.py --log log` (tools: srcx5_list, srcx5_get, srcx5_verify, srcx5_verify_log, srcx5_submit, srcx5_ld)

## Rules
- [Specification v1.4](SPEC_SRCX5_1_4.md): the layer map, transport, the seven checks, quarantine, supersede, audit
